annotations.title: Respond on behalf of a person

description:
Record one person's answer, only when that person asked you to. Which fields you need depends on the decision's type (get_decision shows it in `respond.fields`):
- poll: voter_id + option (exact label) or option_id
- ranking: voter_id + order (every option label or id, best first)
- checkin: name + status (in, maybe, out)
- availability: name + slot_ids (from get_decision `slots`)
Answering again with the same voter_id or name (case-insensitive) replaces that person's earlier answer.

decision_id.description: Decision id or SettleIt link, e.g. "AbC123xYz9" or "https://settleit.now/p/AbC123xYz9".

order.description: ranking: every option label or id, best first.

slot_ids.description: availability: every slot the person can make.

voter_id.description: poll, ranking: stable id for the person, e.g. their name.
